'''Lumas''' was a [[human]] [[Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order]]. In [[22 BBY]], Lumas was part of a [[Jedi assault team]] led by [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] that traveled to the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] in order to try and rescue [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The Jedi infiltrated the [[Petranaki Arena]] where Kenobi was being held and fought against a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army|Droid Army]] there, with Lumas engaging [[battle droid]]s on the arena floor. 

==Biography==
===Strike team Padawan===
{{Quote|I will take what Jedi we have left and go to Geonosis and help Obi-Wan.|Mace Windu|audio=Windu-WhatJedi.flac|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:Geonosis_arena.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Lumas was part of the assault team deployed to the Petranaki Arena (pictured).]]
Lumas<ref name="Inquisitor">''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]''</ref> was a [[human]] member of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]], in which a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|separatist]] faction threatened to break away from the [[Galactic Republic]] that the [[Jedi]] were sworn to protect. While a [[Padawan]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Lumas was part of an [[Jedi assault team|assault team]]<ref name="AOTC" /> of 212 Jedi<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> under the command of [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] who traveled to the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] in order to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a [[Jedi Knight]] who had been captured while [[spy]]ing on the Separatists.<ref name="AOTC" />

Upon arriving on Geonosis, the Jedi infiltrated the [[Petranaki Arena]], where the Separatists were in the process of holding an [[Death penalty|public execution]] for Kenobi, his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker]], and Republic [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. After the [[prisoner]]s had managed to free themselves, Windu confronted Separatist leader, [[Count]] [[Dooku]], and revealed the presence of the assault team, who then emerged within the arena. The Separatists then deployed a [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]] to the arena, and Lumas was among the Jedi who engaged the [[battle droid]]s on the arena floor.<ref name="AOTC" />

===In the arena===
[[File:LumasBlocking-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|Lumas (left) fought droids in the arena.]]
During the fighting, Lumas was deflecting [[blaster]] fire with a [[lightsaber]] when a Jedi next to the Padawan deflected a bolt back at a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (C-3PO)|battle droid]] whose head had been swapped onto the body of [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]], beheading the [[droid]]. The droid forces eventually overwhelmed the Jedi in the arena, surronding a circle of survivors that did not include Lumas. [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] then arrived with [[clone trooper]] reinforcements and rescued those in the circle.<ref name="AOTC" />

Out of the two hundred and twelve Jedi deployed to the arena, only twenty-nine returned. However, the Jedi and Republic were ultimately victorious in the battle, which marked the start of the [[Clone Wars]]. In the [[Standard day|days]] following the battle, Padawan [[Thirteenth Sister|Iskat Akaris]] realised that she had not seen Lumas or the Padawans [[Tan Yuster]] or [[Galdos Stouff]] since Geonosis when thinking about how many Jedi had been lost.<ref name="Inquisitor" />

==Personality and traits==
Lumas had light skin and [[Color|blonde]] [[hair]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Equipment==
While on Geonosis, Lumas wore a dark brown [[Jedi apparel|tunic]] with light brown [[Clothing|pants]], a brown [[belt]], and brown [[boot]]s. The Padawan used a blue lightsaber.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lumas was portrayed by stuntman [[Dean Gould]]<ref name="Actor">{{WebCite|url=http://www.dingostunts.com.au|text=Dingo Stunts|archivedate=20091014195100|nolive=1}}</ref> in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The Jedi battle in the Petranaki Arena scenes were filmed on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]], between [[August 10]] and [[August 15]], [[2000]].<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified as Lumas in the [[2023]] novel ''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]'', written by [[Delilah S. Dawson]].<ref name="Inquisitor" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the character was first identified as [[Lumas Etima]] by the ''[[Star Wars Saga Daily Calendar 2003]]'',<ref name="Calender">''[[Star Wars Saga Daily Calendar 2003]]''</ref> released on [[August 1]], 2002.<ref name="Amazon-Calender">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Classic-Daily-Calendar/dp/0768357705|text=Star Wars Classic Daily Calendar (2003)}}</ref>
